-76.05910,43.04940.name: Boston IVF-The Syracuse Center
-76.05910,43.04940.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Maximillian Klein, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-121.65278,36.68261.name: Planned Parenthood Mar Monte
-121.65278,36.68261.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. Operated by Planned Parenthood. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

2.18358,41.53432.name: AnaPath Research S.A.U.
2.18358,41.53432.state: SANTA PERPETUA DE MOGODA, BARCELONA, SPAIN
2.18358,41.53432.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-80.97387,46.46664.name: Laurentian University
-80.97387,46.46664.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2025
-80.97387,46.46664.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-75.60256,6.26973.name: InSer - Instituto de Fertilidad Humana sede MedellÃ­n
-75.60256,6.26973.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.inser.com.co. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

9.95800,51.55600.name: German Primate Center (DPZ)
9.95800,51.55600.desc: Germany’s national primate research centre, holding monkeys for neuroscience and infection research, and the subject of sustained legal and public challenge. German courts have ruled on whether specific experiments could proceed, which makes this one of the few places the question has been tested in law rather than in policy.

-122.30800,47.65400.name: Institute for Protein Design
-122.30800,47.65400.state: Seattle — 1959 NE Pacific Street, University of Washington
-122.30800,47.65400.desc: Designs proteins that do not exist in nature using deep learning, including binders, enzymes and vaccine scaffolds, and has spun out a series of companies. Its director co-authored the 2024 call for voluntary commitments on AI protein design, which is the field asking for rules on itself in the absence of any.

8.67100,49.39800.name: EMBL — European Molecular Biology Laboratory
8.67100,49.39800.desc: An intergovernmental research organisation funded by 28 member states, running the European Nucleotide Archive and the sequence databases most of this field depends on. Open sequence data is a deliberate arrangement paid for by governments, and it is also what makes any pathogen genome a synthesis template.

121.24410,14.16990.name: University of the Philippines Los Baños
121.24410,14.16990.desc: The public university that developed Bt eggplant and holds its commercial propagation permit, and the body a court ordered to stop propagating it in April 2024. The university's position is that the decision did not revoke its permit and that it complied with the national biosafety framework throughout. Whichever reading prevails, the case establishes that in this jurisdiction a developer can be enjoined directly rather than through the agency that licensed it — which is a different and shorter route than challenging the permit.
